rule: The current Thread Map is the Map of the newest post that carries one, whatever its kind. Newest is code-unit filename order. A post without a Map, or with an empty map: key, never replaces it. A Map that fails to parse is skipped and named; a Map with dropped members still counts. A lookback cap or a partial read that stops before a Map falls back to the opening post's Map and reports stopped. Only canonical direct post files are read.
expected_fields: status, post (id, path and kind) or absent, members (positions of the chosen Map, in order), reason when status is none, skipped, warnings (field and warning of the chosen post's Map), lookback
